source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U15: Apply a conditional payment-time order and update the recovery demand

payload.title: A conditional pause needs an order and compliance
payload.core_explanation_md:
The section 27 framework describes a grant of payment time after the stated minimum down payment and undertaking, on terms acceptable under the provision. The Recovery Officer stay follows receipt of the competent order; a debtor proposal alone is not a stay. Default on the agreed payment terms has the described consequence of withdrawing the stay and resuming recovery of the remaining demand.

Every subsequent payment, time grant and relevant appellate change must be reflected through the proper certificate/recovery records. Do not keep collecting the original figure after an operative reduction, or assume a proposed reduction is already final. The source also states an appeal consequence for this arrangement, which requires explicit primary review before operational advice.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a proposed instalment plan itself pause recovery?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The competent order and its conditions must be established.

payload.title: Calculate the stated minimum down payment
payload.core_explanation_md: Assume a certificate amount INR 920,000 and an otherwise eligible section 27 arrangement requiring at least25% down payment. Calculate the minimum amount only; the order and other conditions are not proved by arithmetic.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: For a stipulated section 27 arrangement, the certificate amount is INR 1,360,000. Calculate the minimum25% down payment in exact INR. Assume all non-numerical conditions are addressed separately.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

payload.stem_md: A debtor proposes instalments but no competent time-grant order has reached the Recovery Officer. What is the correct status?

options.text_md: All recovery is automatically stayed forever
options.explanation_md: A proposal is not an operative stay order.

options.text_md: The certificate has been fully discharged
options.explanation_md: An unpaid proposal is not payment.

options.text_md: The appeal period is automatically restarted
options.explanation_md: A proposed arrangement does not establish that consequence.

options.text_md: The proposed arrangement is pending; any stay depends on the proper order and conditions
options.explanation_md: Track proposal, order and compliance as separate events.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Track proposal, order and compliance as separate events.
